extracted.name: Healthy Ham and Egg Muffins
extracted.description: Ham and egg muffins with a touch of feta cheese are a quick and easy breakfast to eat on the run and can be made in advance and frozen.
ingredient_lines: 1.5 cups frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Spray 12 muffin cups with cooking spray or line with paper liners.
Combine eggs, spinach, red bell pepper, ham, egg whites, feta cheese, water, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Ladle egg mixture into the prepared muffin cups.
Bake in the preheated oven until set in the middle, 20 to 25 minutes.
